notes: A BVG day ticket for zones AB costs about 9 EUR; the Berlin WelcomeCard covers transport plus discounts. The FEX/S9 to BER takes 30-40 minutes. Cycling is ideal in this flat city.
The Reichstag dome is free, but you must register online 2-3 weeks ahead. Museum Island uses timed tickets, and entry is free on the first Sunday of the month (Museumssonntag).
Winter is 0-5°C and grey, and it gets dark by 16:00. Museums are a good bet, and in December there are Christmas markets (Gendarmenmarkt); January is cheap.
Doner is 6-8 EUR (Mustafa's, Rüyam), currywurst 4-5 EUR, and a restaurant meal 15-25 EUR. Tip 5-10% by rounding up; cash is still common.
Shops are closed on Sundays. The Mauerpark flea market is on Sundays, and Markthalle Neun is busiest on Thursday evening.
Clubs (Berghain) run Friday to Sunday; the door policy is selective, so wear black. Photos are banned.

stops.name: Brandenburger Tor
stops.tips: Pariser Platz is empty in the morning; look through the gate towards the Tiergarten.

stops.name: Holocaust Memorial
stops.tips: 2,711 concrete blocks; the underground information centre is free.

stops.name: Reichstag Dome
stops.tips: Free, but book online 2-3 weeks ahead (bring ID). Glass dome with audio guide and city views.

stops.name: Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap
stops.tips: The legendary vegetable doner on Mehringdamm. Expect a 30-60 minute queue, shorter at lunchtime.

stops.name: Gendarmenmarkt
stops.tips: Berlin's most beautiful square, with its twin cathedrals and the Konzerthaus.

backups.name: Curry 36 Mehringdamm
backups.tips: Currywurst opposite Mustafa's, if there's no queue.

backups.name: Berlin Cathedral
backups.tips: Climb the cathedral dome (270 steps); right by Museum Island.

stops.name: Pergamonmuseum Das Panorama
stops.tips: The main building is closed until 2027; the Ishtar Gate panorama and Pergamon pieces are in the neighbouring building.

stops.name: Neues Museum
stops.tips: Home of the Nefertiti bust. Book a timed ticket online; the Museum Island day pass is 24 EUR.

stops.name: Alte Nationalgalerie
stops.tips: Caspar David Friedrich and the German Romantics.

stops.name: Hackescher Markt Yemek
stops.tips: The courtyards of the Hackesche Höfe, with cafes and street food.

stops.name: Hackesche Höfe & Haus Schwarzenberg
stops.tips: Art nouveau courtyards and the graffiti-covered Schwarzenberg courtyard (Anne Frank Zentrum).

backups.name: Bode Museum
backups.tips: Byzantine art and sculpture, at the tip of the island by the river.

backups.name: Zeit für Brot Alte Schönhauser
backups.tips: Bakery known for its cinnamon rolls.

days.theme: The Wall: Bernauer and East Side

stops.name: Berlin Wall Memorial Bernauer Strasse
stops.tips: An original section of the Wall, the death strip and a documentation centre. The most honest account of the Wall, and free.

stops.name: Mauerpark
stops.tips: Flea market and karaoke on Sundays; on other days, a park with Wall graffiti.

stops.name: Prenzlauer Berg Kollwitzplatz
stops.tips: Cafes and Kastanienallee; market Thursday to Saturday.

stops.name: Konnopke's Imbiss
stops.tips: Currywurst under the U-Bahn tracks since 1930, an East Berlin classic.

stops.name: East Side Gallery
stops.tips: 1.3 km of paintings on the Wall, including the Brezhnev-Honecker kiss. Walk on to Oberbaumbrücke.

backups.name: Burgermeister Schlesisches Tor
backups.tips: Burgers in a former public toilet building, near the East Side Gallery.

backups.name: Checkpoint Charlie
backups.tips: A tourist crossing point; the Mauermuseum charges admission. Choose it instead of East Side.

stops.name: Markthalle Neun
stops.tips: Kreuzberg's market hall: Street Food Thursday, and a market on Saturday.

stops.name: Landwehrkanal Walk
stops.tips: A stroll along the canal; the Turkish market at Maybachufer runs Tuesday to Friday.

stops.name: Tempelhofer Feld
stops.tips: A vast, windswept open space in winter; keep the walk short.

stops.name: Neukölln Weserstrasse
stops.tips: Bars and cafes in Berlin's young neighbourhood.

stops.name: Hamy Cafe Neukölln
stops.tips: Vietnamese cuisine; a cheap Neukölln favourite.

backups.name: Jewish Museum Berlin
backups.tips: A Libeskind building; choose it over Tempelhof in the rain.

stops.name: Charlottenburg Palace
stops.tips: Prussian palace with a baroque garden: the Altes Schloss and Neuer Flügel.

stops.name: Charlottenburg Palace Gardens
stops.tips: The palace gardens, with a lake; free.

stops.name: Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
stops.tips: A bombed-out tower beside the new church with its blue glass.

stops.name: KaDeWe 6th Floor Food Hall
stops.tips: Europe's largest food hall; eat oysters or wurst at the counter.

stops.name: Bikini Berlin & Zoo
stops.tips: A concept mall with a terrace overlooking the zoo (Monkey Bar).

backups.name: Berlin Zoo
backups.tips: Germany's oldest zoo; choose it instead of the mall.

stops.name: Sanssouci Palace
stops.tips: 40 minutes on the S7. Frederick's palace with vineyard terraces; timed ticket.

stops.name: Sanssouci Park
stops.tips: Walk through the park to the Chinese House and the New Palace; 300 hectares.

stops.name: Dutch Quarter Potsdam
stops.tips: The Dutch Quarter, with red-brick houses and cafes.

stops.name: Maison Charlotte Potsdam
stops.tips: A French bistro in the Dutch Quarter.

stops.name: Cecilienhof
stops.tips: The country house where the 1945 Potsdam Conference took place; see the Truman-Stalin-Churchill table.

backups.name: Glienicke Bridge
backups.tips: The spy bridge; choose it instead of Cecilienhof.

stops.name: Berlin TV Tower
stops.tips: The 203 m TV tower. Book the first slot of the morning online; it has a revolving restaurant.

stops.name: Nikolaiviertel
stops.tips: Berlin's oldest quarter (rebuilt), with the Nikolaikirche.

stops.name: Zur Letzten Instanz
stops.tips: Berlin's oldest restaurant, open since 1621; try the eisbein (boiled pork knuckle).

stops.name: Alexanderplatz World Clock
stops.tips: The World Time Clock. The Airport Express to BER takes 30 minutes: time to say goodbye.

backups.name: DDR Museum
backups.tips: An interactive museum of everyday life in East Germany.
